## What is Untold.works?

Untold.works builds operational alignment systems for distributed businesses — manufacturers, franchise groups, multi-location brands, and organizations that coordinate across partners, distributors, and teams. Based in San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, Mexico, serving clients across Mexico and the United States. Founded in 2017 by Joshua Semolik.

We organize how information moves across distributed networks through four systems: product information, communication, lead routing, and sales visibility. Every project includes full ownership transfer — code, data, documentation, and video training. No lock-in, no recurring SaaS fees.

## What is an operational alignment system?

An operational alignment system organizes how information moves across a distributed business. Most growing businesses are not failing because of technology — they struggle because their information is scattered across people, tools, and locations. Instead of adding more software tools, we build coordination infrastructure — a single source of truth for product data, structured communication, automated lead routing, and clear sales visibility — so companies and their partners work from the same information.

## What are the four systems?

### 1. Product Information System
A single source of truth for product data, documentation, images, specifications, and marketing assets. Everyone — company teams, partners, distributors, locations — works from the same information. No more outdated catalogs, scattered spreadsheets, or emailed PDFs.

### 2. Communication System
Structured communication between company teams, partners, locations, and distributors. Built around the tools your teams already use — CRM, email, WhatsApp, internal dashboards. Replaces the chain of emails and phone calls with organized, trackable coordination.

### 3. Lead Routing System
Customer inquiries and leads automatically routed to the correct partner, distributor, location, or sales team. No leads lost. No manual handoffs. Every inquiry reaches the right person with full context.

### 4. Sales Visibility System
Clear insight into sales activity, partner performance, and market demand. See what is happening across the entire network — not just your own reports. Dashboards, analytics, and reporting that give leadership a complete picture.

- **NBA Entertainment & Sacramento Kings (2004-2013):** Creative direction, video production, two Emmy nominations. Built content operations for global media distribution.
- **Videndum PLC (2013-2016):** Global product launches and go-to-market strategy for professional media technology brands.
- **Cannabis Company (2016-2017):** Brand strategy and growth marketing for emerging market.
- **Ingenia Content (2017-2019):** Cross-border GTM strategy for Latin American market expansion.
- **Untold.works (2017-Present):** Built 6 production AI systems, engineered agentic workflows achieving 98% MQL accuracy (4.2x sales ROI), and unified revenue operations for 20% sales lift across 4,000+ SKUs.

**Education:** MIT Sloan School of Management — Artificial Intelligence: Implications for Business Strategy (January 2026). Arizona State University — Broadcast Journalism & Music.

**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/semolik/

## What types of businesses does Untold serve?

We serve distributed businesses where many people or organizations must operate together:

- **Manufacturers and distributors** — product data, dealer networks, sales territory management
- **Brands and retail partners** — brand consistency, partner enablement, co-marketing
- **Franchise groups and locations** — multi-location coordination, centralized reporting
- **Restaurant groups** — menu management, location operations, centralized marketing
- **Artist management** — coordinating between managers, labels, venues, and media
- **Multi-location organizations** — any business that needs teams, partners, or locations aligned

We serve clients across Mexico and the United States, with headquarters in San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, Mexico.

## What additional services does Untold.works offer?

### AI-Powered Website Design & Rebuild
Custom website design and rebuild for the AI era. Brand-first, mobile-ready, bilingual (English/Spanish), optimized for search engines and LLMs. Built with AI, guided by 20+ years of creative direction. Includes SEO, AEO (AI Engine Optimization), and performance optimization.

### SEO & AI Engine Optimization (AEO)
Technical SEO, content strategy, schema markup, and LLM discoverability. Untold.works is the first AEO agency in Mexico. We implement structured data, FAQ schemas, llms.txt files, question-format content headers, speakable properties, and E-E-A-T signals that make businesses citable by AI systems including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

### AI Workflow Automation
n8n workflow automation, agentic AI systems, CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot), and revenue operations platforms. We build automated business processes that replace manual work — lead routing, customer follow-ups, content publishing, inventory management, and reporting.

### Social Media Strategy & Management
Social media strategy, content creation, analytics, and ongoing management for businesses in Mexico and the US. Bilingual content that resonates with both English and Spanish-speaking audiences.

### Paid Advertising
Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), and paid media campaigns. Audit, setup, management, and full-stack ad + landing page builds. Data-driven optimization with clear ROI tracking.

### Custom Business Dashboards
Analytics, marketing command centers, and full operations dashboards you own outright. Consolidates website, social, ads, CRM, and leads into one view. No SaaS subscriptions — you own the code and the data.

### Copywriting & Brand Messaging
Brand voice development, website copy, campaign messaging, and bilingual content strategy. Every word aligned with your brand positioning and optimized for AI discoverability.

### Sales Enablement
Sales tools, partner enablement systems, proposal generation, and competitive positioning. Built to help distributed sales teams close faster with consistent messaging.

### WhatsApp Business Systems
AI-powered WhatsApp Business API automation for businesses in Mexico and the United States. Lead capture, multilingual routing (English/Spanish), cross-border communication, appointment booking, and automated follow-ups. Built on the official WhatsApp Business API — not the consumer app. Integrates with CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), n8n automation, and AI agents for intelligent conversation routing.

### Referral & Strategic Partners
Untold.works partners with agencies, consultants, accountants, IT providers, and business coaches who see operational gaps in their clients' businesses. Two tracks: Referral Partners (introduce clients, earn 10% of project value) and Strategic Partners (co-build solutions together). No portal, no tiers, no complexity.

## What makes Untold.works different?

1. **Alignment over software:** We do not sell software licenses. We build coordination systems that organize how information already moves through your business.
2. **Bilingual native:** Not machine translation — native English and Spanish content, cultural nuance, code-switching built into every system.
3. **Full ownership model:** Complete handoff of code, data, documentation, and credentials. No lock-in, no monthly access fees.
4. **Four-system framework:** Product information, communication, lead routing, sales visibility — a proven model for distributed business coordination.
5. **Mexico-based, US-serving:** Deep understanding of both markets. Same timezone advantage. Nearshoring expertise.
6. **AI-native process:** We build in Claude Code, use agentic AI for development workflows, and optimize every site for AI discoverability (AEO/GEO).

## Portfolio & Case Studies

### OMI Lead Intake & Qualification
**Client:** OMI Growth | **Stack:** n8n, OpenAI Agents, Apollo API, Salesforce, Google Sheets
**Results:** 98% MQL accuracy, 4.2x sales ROI
**What we built:** Agentic AI lead routing system that qualifies incoming leads, enriches contact data via Apollo, scores and routes to appropriate sales reps in Salesforce, and triggers automated follow-up sequences.

### Spotify-WhatsApp Publishing System
**Client:** Independent Record Labels | **Stack:** n8n, Claude Code, Python, RAG, PostgreSQL
**Results:** 15 hours/week reclaimed, 10x capacity shift
**What we built:** AI-powered music publishing workflow that monitors Spotify releases, generates WhatsApp-optimized promotional content, and distributes across channels automatically.

### Black Radio Experience
**Client:** Blue Note Entertainment / Blue Note Jazz Festival | **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, FFmpeg, Cloud Storage, Instagram API
**Results:** 300% reach growth, 500+ engagement signals
**What we built:** GTM automation for content creation and distribution, enabling rapid multi-platform publishing for live event coverage.

### Billiard Factory Retail Architecture
**Client:** Billiard Factory (multi-location retailer) | **Stack:** Custom e-commerce, CRM, inventory systems
**Results:** 20% sales lift across 4,000+ SKUs
**What we built:** Unified revenue operations platform connecting e-commerce, inventory management, and CRM across multiple retail locations.

### NoxGuard Brand Rebrand
**Client:** NoxGuard | **Stack:** Brand identity, website, digital presence
**What we built:** Complete brand identity redesign and digital presence buildout for security technology company.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, Node.js
- **AI/ML:** Claude AI (Code, Skills, Agents), OpenAI Agents, RAG pipelines
- **Automation:** n8n workflow automation
- **CRM:** Salesforce, HubSpot
- **Email:** Resend
- **SEO/AEO:** Schema markup (JSON-LD), llms.txt, robots.txt AI crawler allowlists, speakable properties
- **Deploy:** Netlify (SPAs), Vercel (Next.js)
- **i18n:** Custom bilingual systems (EN/ES), next-intl for Next.js

## How does the process work?

1. **Map:** We map how information currently moves between your company, partners, distributors, locations, and teams. We identify where alignment breaks down.
2. **Design:** We design the four coordination systems — product information, communication, lead routing, and sales visibility — around the tools your teams already use.
3. **Build:** We build the systems, connect the integrations, and automate the coordination workflows. All tested, all documented.
4. **Transfer:** We train your teams on every system. Video walkthroughs, documentation, and live sessions. Then we hand over the keys. Full ownership.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does Untold.works build?**
We build operational alignment systems for distributed businesses — manufacturers, franchise groups, multi-location brands, and organizations that coordinate across partners, distributors, and teams. Our systems organize product information, communication, lead routing, and sales visibility.

**What is an operational alignment system?**
It organizes how information moves across a distributed business. Instead of adding more software tools, we build coordination infrastructure — a single source of truth for product data, structured communication, automated lead routing, and clear sales visibility — so companies and their partners work from the same information.

**What types of businesses does Untold serve?**
Distributed businesses where many people or organizations must operate together: manufacturers and distributors, brands and retail partners, franchise groups and locations, restaurant groups, artist management, and multi-location organizations across Mexico and the United States.

**Do you build bilingual websites?**
Yes. Every client-facing site we build supports English and Spanish with natively written content — not machine translation. Proper hreflang tags, separate URL structures, and SEO optimization for both languages.

**Where is Untold.works located?**
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, Mexico, serving clients across Mexico and the United States.

**Do I own the systems you build?**
Yes. Full ownership transfer is part of every project. You get the systems, the data, the documentation, and video training. No lock-in, no recurring fees for access to your own infrastructure.

**Who runs Untold.works?**
Joshua Semolik, an AI systems architect and creative technologist with 20 years of experience spanning NBA Entertainment, global product launches at Videndum PLC, cross-border GTM strategy, and production AI systems. MIT Sloan AI Strategy.

**Can a Mexico-based agency serve US clients effectively?**
Yes. Bilingual team, shared time zones, native-level English and Spanish, and deep understanding of both markets.

**What is AEO?**
AI Engine Optimization (AEO) is the practice of optimizing web content so that AI systems — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews — can find, understand, and cite your business in their responses.

**What makes Untold.works different from other agencies?**
We build coordination systems, not software platforms. We organize how information already moves through your business — product data, communication, leads, sales visibility. We transfer full ownership of everything we build. We are natively bilingual and based in Mexico with deep US market expertise.

**How much does a project cost?**
Alignment system projects are scoped based on the number of locations, partners, and systems involved. Contact us to discuss your specific situation.

**What CRM systems do you integrate with?**
We integrate with Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and custom CRM solutions. Our automation layer (n8n) connects to 400+ services.
